__inputs.name: DS_AE_METRICS
__inputs.label: Rajahinta AE metrics (Cloudflare Analytics Engine SQL)
__inputs.description: A JSON/Infinity-type Grafana data source pointing POST queries at the Cloudflare Analytics Engine SQL API (see apps/api-worker/src/observability/METRICS.md 'Querying'). Credentials live in the data source config, never in this file.

panels.description: The ingestion price-floor gate (task 1.1) rejects non-positive cent prices before publication; each run writes its per-run count to rajahinta_data_quality_zero_price_rejections_total. Any non-zero value is a feed publishing price drift — alert RajahintaZeroPriceRejectionsNew.

targets.data: SELECT timestamp, JSONExtractString(blob3, 'merchant') AS merchant, double1 * _sample_interval AS rejections FROM ${AE_DATASET} WHERE index1 = 'rajahinta_data_quality_zero_price_rejections_total' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: Zero-price rejections per ingestion run

panels.description: Share of audited offers whose implausible unit volume the ceiling gate (task 1.2) withheld pre-upsert — rajahinta_data_quality_implausible_volume_share_ratio, latest observation. 0 with a healthy pipeline is normal; a rising share means feed volumes drifting outside the category ceilings.

targets.data: SELECT timestamp, double1 AS implausible_volume_share FROM ${AE_DATASET} WHERE index1 = 'rajahinta_data_quality_implausible_volume_share_ratio' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: Implausible-volume share

panels.description: Share of catalog products carrying a usable Alko reference offer (the savings-snapshot qualification: an Alko offer row with an observation instant) — rajahinta_data_quality_alko_reference_coverage_ratio, latest observation. A drop to (near) zero kills the savings surface — alert RajahintaAlkoReferenceCoverageNearZero.

targets.data: SELECT timestamp, double1 AS alko_reference_coverage FROM ${AE_DATASET} WHERE index1 = 'rajahinta_data_quality_alko_reference_coverage_ratio' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: Alko reference coverage %

panels.description: Rows in the append-only transport_offers table per carrier — rajahinta_transport_offer_rows (carrier label), latest observation per carrier. Expected curated carriers (fransberg, posti) are written as honest 0s when their table is empty — alert RajahintaTransportOfferRowsZero.

targets.data: SELECT timestamp, JSONExtractString(blob3, 'carrier') AS carrier, double1 AS transport_rows FROM ${AE_DATASET} WHERE index1 = 'rajahinta_transport_offer_rows' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '3' DAY ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: Transport offer rows per carrier

panels.description: Age of the newest published offer per registry feed (feed_url non-empty) — rajahinta_feed_last_success_age_seconds (merchant label), latest observation. Every successful ingestion stamps fresh observedAt instants, so this is the per-feed last-success signal. A feed that never published renders +Inf (the 9007199254740991 sentinel) — alert RajahintaFeedLastSuccessStale.

targets.data: SELECT timestamp, JSONExtractString(blob3, 'merchant') AS merchant, double1 AS feed_last_success_age_seconds FROM ${AE_DATASET} WHERE index1 = 'rajahinta_feed_last_success_age_seconds' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '3' DAY ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: Per-feed last-success age

panels.description: Reference surface for the freshness pair the in-Worker checker (task 6.3) alerts on: stale-price share and transport newest-offer age — documented in METRICS.md, evaluated from D1 by the cron checker (which must not scrape AE).

options.content: Freshness invariants (stale-price share > 0.10/0.25, transport age > 45/90 d) are evaluated from D1 by the api-worker freshness-alert cron (src/cron/freshness-alert.ts) and delivered via the email Worker — they intentionally do not page from this dashboard. This panel documents the split: data-quality regressions page from Grafana; freshness invariants page from the cron checker.

panels.title: Where freshness alerts live

panels.description: Share of the aggregation pass's products-with-observations that have daily price_history_summaries buckets — rajahinta_history_summary_coverage_ratio, latest observation (design D4, watermark-isolation-history-backfill; written AFTER the pass's writes). Healthy = exactly 1; below 1 is the coverage-gap failure class (permanent gray "Hintahistoria" skeletons) — alert RajahintaHistorySummaryCoverageBelowInvariant. A vacuously-complete window (0 products with observations) writes the +Inf sentinel (9007199254740991), filtered out here: gaps in the series are empty windows, not missing data.

targets.data: SELECT timestamp, double1 AS summary_coverage FROM ${AE_DATASET} WHERE index1 = 'rajahinta_history_summary_coverage_ratio' AND double1 < 9007199254740991 AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: History summary coverage

list.description: Analytics Engine dataset per environment (design D9) — dev/staging/production names in METRICS.md.
list.label: AE dataset
list.name: AE_DATASET
list.query: production : rajahinta-api-metrics-production, staging : rajahinta-api-metrics-staging, dev : rajahinta-api-metrics-dev

list.description: Cloudflare account id — part of the AE SQL API URL. Enter once on import (or bake the literal into the panel URLs).
list.label: CF account id
list.name: CF_ACCOUNT_ID
